law.catch_line: Riding animals on highways after sunset

text.section:
No person riding upon any animal on a highway between sunset and sunrise shall ride the animal on the roadway unless the rider:
Wears a hat made of or coated with reflectorized material; or
Wears upper body clothing made of or coated with reflectorized material visible from 360°; or
Displays at least 100 square inches of solid reflectorized material at shoulder level visible from 360°; or
Carries a light visible in clear weather from a distance of 500 feet.
The requirements of subsection A of this section shall only apply to the riders of the first and last animals in a group riding one behind the other.
A violation of this section shall not be construed as negligence per se in any civil action.
